conflicts.description: Contradiction regarding which phase gives the lowest elastic modulus: single metastable β vs. α''+β dual phase.

claims.statement: Most researchers asserted that single metastable β-type Ti alloys possessed lower elastic moduli than α- or (α+β)-type Ti alloys.
